symbols.name: source length
symbols.meaning: The odd prime length chosen for axis $i$, just below its padded length $t_i$.
symbols.quote: A prime source length is an odd prime $s_i$ chosen just below the padded length of its axis.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: An index from $1$ to $d$ labelling the axes.
symbols.quote: Here $i$ indexes the $d$ axes, $i=1,\dots,d$, and $t_i$ is a power of two, the padded length of axis $i$.

symbols.name: source product
symbols.meaning: The product of the source lengths $s_i$ over all axes.
symbols.quote: Write $S=\prod_i s_i$ for the product of the source lengths and $T=\prod_i t_i$ for the padded box.

symbols.name: window gap
symbols.meaning: A gap with $0<\eta<1/4$ that sets the width of each prime window.

symbols.name: padded length variable
symbols.meaning: A real number standing for a large power-of-two padded length in the prime-count statement.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ be a real number standing for a padded length; the letter $x$ means an input string on earlier pages, and it changes meaning here.

symbols.name: prime in window
symbols.meaning: A prime ranging over the interval $(1-2\eta)x<q\le(1-\eta)x$.

relations.quote: The lengths $s_i$ are the moduli of the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which turns one cyclic convolution of length $S$ into a multidimensional one over the $s_i$.
The primes are sized for [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which needs each ratio $t_i/s_i$ to leave separation.
